title: Photon-counting CT Scan vs Standard HRCT Scan in the Identification of Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
official: Photon-counting CT Scan vs Standard HRCT Scan in the Identification of Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
summary: The CT-IPF ANTHEM study is designed to prospectively compare PCDCT to HRCT scan in the identification of specific ILD diagnosis discussed during the multidisciplinary discussion to increase diagnostic confidence and reduce unclassifiable ILD cases.
conditions: Interstitial Lung Disease Due to Systemic Disease (Telomere Biology Disorder)
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* ≥ 18 years of age
* Any gender
* Any race
* Signed informed consent
* ILD diagnosis with the need for a multidisciplinary discussion

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with acute exacerbation of ILD
* Interstitial abnormalities that could be explained by causes different than ILD (e.g.: heart failure; viral)
